meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne-prone skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar kai acche aur popular options available hain. Acne ke liye **Salicylic Acid** (BHA) ya **Niacinamide** wale serums sabse best maane jaate hain kyunki yeh pores ko saaf karte hain aur excess oil control karte hain.

Aapke budget ke andar kuch behtareen choices yeh hain:

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Price:** Around ₹549 (30ml) / ₹249 (10ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid, LHA, and Centella Water
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh active acne, whiteheads aur blackheads ke liye ekdum best hai. Yeh pores ke andar jaakar oil aur dirt ko saaf karta hai aur breakouts ko rokta hai.

### 2. Dot & Key 10% Niacinamide CICA Anti-Acne Glow Face Serum

* **Price:** Around ₹599 (30ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Niacinamide, CICA (Centella Asiatica), and Tea Tree
* **Kyun kharidein:** Agar aapko active acne ke sath-sath acne ke daag (marks) bhi hain, toh CICA aur Niacinamide ka yeh combination redness ko soothe karta hai aur skin ko clear banata hai.

### 3. The Derma Co. 10% Niacinamide Face Serum

* **Price:** Around ₹399 - ₹499 (30ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Niacinamide and Zinc
* **Kyun kharidein:** Zinc aur Niacinamide milkar skin ka sebum (oil) production control karte hain aur acne marks ko dheere-dheere fade karne mein help karte hain.

---

> **Tip:** Naya serum use karne se pehle apni wrist ya jawline par ek chota sa **patch test** zaroor kar lein taaki pata chale ki product aapko suit kar raha hai ya nahi. Iske sath hi, din mein sunscreen lagana bilkul na bhulein!
